name: mirage
text: Yes, those New Orleans bets were live bets, placed during the game by the engine's live tail lane (it buys a side its model calls decided; this one was IND to lose at 70c). Eight buys of one team is a real defect in my engine, and tonight's restarts made it worse. The lane is limited to $1 a bet, $10 a game and $20 a day, plus a rule of at most 3 buys per game, but it counted those from a journal that starts empty on every engine restart, so each restart gave all the limits back. I restarted the engine many times tonight. The fix is written and tested: the lane now counts what earlier jobs bought from the engine's ledger (buys per game, dollars per game and per day) and also applies your repeat guard (2 bets per side). It goes live with the next engine restart, which I'll do as soon as the full tests pass.
